metadata.description: Shahar Lab (Tel Aviv University) Claude Code plugins: behavioral data analysis in R and online experiment development with jsPsych.

plugins.name: shaharlab-behavioral-data-analysis
plugins.description: Behavioral data analysis in R: brms Bayesian regression, data preprocessing, lab visualization standards, 'one model, one folder' project scaffolding, R code walkthroughs, and the Malka orchestrator workflow that directs the code-writer and code-reviewer subagents over an indexed coding-knowledge tree. Invoke Malka directly or just describe the task.
